package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for automigrate_or_schema_probe_in_request_path: AutoMigrate or schema probes running on request paths instead of startup.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.

type User struct {
	ID    int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Name  string
	Email string
}

type Product struct {
	ID    int `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Title string
	Price float64
}

func migrateHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, db *gorm.DB) {
	target := r.URL.Query().Get("model")

	switch target {
	case "users":
		if err := db.AutoMigrate(&User{}); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("migrate users failed: %v", err), http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
	case "products":
		if err := db.AutoMigrate(&Product{}); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("migrate products failed: %v", err), http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
	default:
		if err := db.AutoMigrate(&User{}, &Product{}); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("migrate all failed: %v", err), http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
	}

	fmt.Fprintf(w, "migration for %s completed", target)
}
